material: CuO (tenorite), monoclinic C2/c, 4 Cu per conventional cell. Released calculations of Tellez-Mora, He, Bousquet, Wirtz and Romero (2024): SIESTA DFT+U (U = 7.14 eV on Cu 3d), exchange from the magnetic force theorem (Green-function method) with TB2J 0.7.4.5.
exchange_convention: Archived TB2J convention: E = -sum_{i != j} J_ij e_i.e_j over ordered pairs (each bond appears twice, as (i,j,R) and (j,i,-R)), e_i unit vectors along the local moments, J > 0 ferromagnetic, meV. R is in lattice vectors of the calculation's own cell; vector = r_j + R.cell - r_i in Angstrom.
isotropic_only: Only isotropic exchange is served: the archive README states that only the isotropic exchange constants are valid.

conventional_cell.note: Cell and Cartesian frame of the FM-reference calculations. Wave vectors in this task are in reciprocal-lattice units of this cell.

calculation_notes: Each calculation was done in its own cell and magnetic configuration; the cell, atoms, charges and moments of a calculation are returned with every exchange purchase from it. "Spin-ligand correction" is TB2J's correction for the ligand (O) spin polarisation.

exchange.returns: all isotropic pairs of that calculation with lo <= distance < hi, as rows [i, j, Rx, Ry, Rz, J_iso_meV, dx_A, dy_A, dz_A, distance_A], plus the calculation metadata (TB2J header lines, cell, atoms with charges and moments).

author_dispersion.returns: the archived file of eigenvalues of the paper's bosonic matrix h(k) (Eq. 9) for that calculation's reference configuration, 300 k-points along the path named in its header line. The k-point coordinates and units are not archived.
